If you have any problem with how to register, take a look at [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410). If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, gender, date of birth and nationality. There will be an extra prize between the 3 students from Colégio Modelo São Sebastião best placed in the 3x3 event.
